ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment occupies the central and medial regions extending from the peduncle junction. High-intensity white fields are localized on the distal lateral lobes. Left lobe white field contains dense, irregular black punctate mottling. Right lobe white field contains sparse, discrete black speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; exact apex depth and angle are null due to occlusion by water turbulence and splash at the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits higher amplitude indentations (jagged) compared to the right lobe which shows more frequent, lower amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast brown and white textured clusters localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct white linear marks oriented vertically on the inner black region of the left lobe; two diagonal white linear marks on the inner black region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable semi-circular indentation (missing tissue) on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and turbulence obscure the peduncle and the lower-most portion of the fluke-ventral surface.
